name: BBCode markup
summary: A light markup for forum posts: the poster writes tags in square brackets, and the board changes them into safe HTML.
how: Write the format in square-bracket tags, for example [b]bold[/b] or [quote]...[/quote].
Let the board change each tag into HTML and remove raw HTML from the post.
Show a quote of the earlier post in a box with the name of its poster.

origin.note: BBCode was first introduced in 1998 as a markup for message boards.

adoptions.via: phpBB 3.1 has a completely rewritten BBCode system for the posts on its boards.
